alice_sre: SLO alert: hosted-infer p99 timeouts spiking in ap-south-1 for the last 10m. Multiple CS tickets — customers seeing 502/504 and streaming cutoffs. Anyone oncall?
jordan_oncall: I'm on it, pulling Grafana now. Do we have a deploy in the last hour?
priya_support: Customers report requests hang ~10s then 504. Affects both text-generation and embeddings. Sample request ids: req_id=abc123, req_id=def456 (from CS threads).
alice_sre: Not a deploy — last deploy was ~2h ago. I see a big tail latency bump on the ingress proxy dashboard for ap-south-1. Dashboard link: /d/hosted-infer/slo-overview?orgId=1&var-region=ap-south-1
jordan_oncall: Running a log query to scope it: "proxy.request.duration_ms > 5000 and response.status >= 500" — lots of hits showing upstream connect timeouts.
jordan_oncall: Query I'm using (Grafana Loki / TraceQL):
```
trace | where region == "ap-south-1" and status_code >= 500 and duration_ms > 3000
| summarize count() by upstream_service, bin(timestamp, 1m)
```
priya_support: Tracing gap on many entries — no backend spans. Looks like requests fail before the inference container responds. Could be connection handshake / keepaliveissue between proxy and backend.
maya_support: Customers say retries with backoff reduce errors temporarily. Not ideal but useful for mitigation notes.
alice_sre: Can someone check node-level connection stats (tcp_established, tcp_retransmits) and fd counts on proxy pods? Suspect fd exhaustion or lingering sockets. I'll pull proxy metrics: tcp_conn_drops and keepalive_failures.
ops_lead: Scaling up dedicated pool in ap-south-1 as a temporary mitigation (2x nodes) and enabling fallback routing to a compatible model variant to reduce tail load.
jordan_oncall: Created quick runbook and load replay plan: /runbooks/ingress-timeout-wave.md. Will try a canary restart of the proxy to see if error rate drops, and add socket-level spans to tracing. @infra-bot please run a config sanity check on proxy timeouts.
infra-bot: Config check complete — proxy timeouts and upstream keepalive values match staging baseline. No recent config changes detected. Kernel tcp_keepalive params at defaults.
alice_sre: Plan: 1) collect tcp kernel stats + dmesg from affected hosts, 2) enable TCP keepalive logging on proxy for 15m, 3) canary restart proxy in one AZ, 4) CS communication. Assigning to @jordan_oncall and @priya_support.
priya_support: Acknowledged — I'll update the CS tickets with temporary mitigation and gather customer-side traces.
jordan_oncall: Update +12m: Canary restart in one AZ reduced 5xx rate ~40% for that AZ. Heap/GC look fine but fd usage spiked before restart. Evidence points to file-descriptor leak in proxy v2 under long-lived connections. Captured metrics and pprof. Opening PR to add fd metrics and tighter idle-socket close.
alice_sre: Good catch. Tagging incident and starting a postmortem stub. Please attach logs, sample request ids, and the runbook results. :thumbsup:
